integrity: The exact decomposition and inverse reconstruction have a direct proof; computational tests are corroborating only. Literature priority beyond checked statements remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Complete multipartite underlying graphs with all edge labels distinct; not arbitrary graphical Lie algebras.
Odd prime-power coefficient field; tests use only small prime fields.
The graph is the full commuting graph on all algebra elements, not the projective/noncentral noncommuting graph.
No independent review or exhaustive priority determination.
title: Finite-field reconstruction from commuting graphs of complete multipartite graphical Lie algebras
